Class CustomCrop

java.lang.Object
dev.lone.itemsadder.api.CustomCrop
public class CustomCrop extends Object
Wrapper for a custom crop placed in the world.

      @Nullable public static @Nullable CustomCrop place(String seedId, Location location)
